annotation.title_clean: RDAC 101 Sistemas de Aeronaves no Tripuladas (UAS) - Resolución Nro. DGAC-DGAC-2024-0100-R
annotation.title_en: RDAC 101 Unmanned Aircraft Systems (UAS) - Resolution No. DGAC-DGAC-2024-0100-R
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Dirección General de Aviación Civil (DGAC), Ecuador
annotation.summary_en: Ecuador's civil aviation authority resolution approving RDAC 101, the binding regulation for unmanned aircraft systems up to 250 kg. It sets open, specific and reserved certified categories, drone registration, remote pilot authorization, operator certificates (UOC), operating rules, insurance, incident reporting and safety management, replacing the 2024 RPAS rules.
key_provisions_or_claims: Risk-based categories: open (≤4 kg, recreational), specific (≤250 kg, commercial/private), certified (reserved)
Registration required for UAS over 250 g; remote pilot authorization and UAS Operator Certificate (UOC) for specific category
Rules on VLOS/EVLOS/BVLOS, autonomous operation (human takeover capability, 1,000 m limit), 122 m height limit, flight restriction zones
Operator and pilot civil liability, mandatory third-party liability insurance, accident reporting within 24 hours
Safety management system, C2 link validation and detect-and-avoid requirements for BVLOS
